SHEETS IN GREY ARE BUILT BUT NOT PART OF THE ISSUE — WITHDRAWN OR NOT SELECTED, AND EACH SAYS WHICH ON ITS FACE
PROJECT DATA · DRAWING INDEX · REVISION P34
1. The index is built, not listed: every row is a sheet this
project can actually draw, with the title and revision
that sheet carries. An index typed beside the drawings
goes wrong within a revision or two, and it is the one
document a reader trusts when deciding a drawing does not
2. Rows in grey are built but outside the issue, and each
says why on its own face: the A-300 enlargements are
withdrawn at P22, being of apartments the villa no longer
has, and the scheme B and C elevations are stamped not
3. The prefix is part of the number. A-402 is the street
elevation and ARC-402 the second floor's ceiling plan.
4. Deliverables beyond the drawings — the structural,
services and quantities packages — are registered on
5. Not for construction. Issued for the owner's record,
EZBIT ABU RUKBAH, QUESNA, MENOUFIA, EGYPT
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
